description: Staff Assistant position. Job duties include answering and directing incoming calls and constituent inquiries, assisting visitors, working with the District Director, ordering office supplies, handling deliveries, and performing general administrative assignments. Featured skills include adaptability, attention to detail, constituent/stakeholder service, interpersonal skills, and verbal communication. Preferences include a Bachelor's degree, prior constituent service experience, demonstrated interest in public service, and ties to the District.
responsibilities: Answers and directs incoming calls and constituent inquiries to appropriate staff
Assists visitors who have appointments with the Member or other staff
Works closely with the District Director to ensure that the Member's appointments are on time
Orders all office supplies to maintain office equipment
Signs for deliveries and forwards all materials delivered to ensure timely and appropriate handling
Performs general administrative assignments as assigned to assist the office staff with work
qualifications: Adaptability: Adapts quickly to change or unexpected obstacles; easily considers new approaches
Attention to Detail: Performs work thoroughly and accurately; acts conscientiously when attending to detail
Constituent/Stakeholder Service Driven: Anticipates and meets the needs of constituents; delivers high-quality products and services
Interpersonal Skills: Develops and maintains effective relationships with others from diverse backgrounds and in different situations; shows understanding, courtesy, tact, empathy, and politeness
Verbal Communication: Makes clear and convincing oral presentations appropriate to listeners and situations; listens effectively, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience preferred
Prior constituent service or customer relationship management is preferred
Demonstrated interest in public service is preferred
Ties to the District is preferred
how_to_apply: Interested applicants should e-mail a resume, cover letter, and a one-page writing sample to Sydney.Long@Mail.House.Gov with the subject "Staff Assistant: LAST NAME" by October 3rd, 2025. Incomplete or late applications will not be considered.
equal_opportunity: All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including marital or parental status), sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, or national origin.

In addition to managing the legislative operation, the Legislative Director will mentor junior staff and support the professional development of the policy team.

Strong knowledge of House legislative procedures, floor operations, and committee work
Temperament to communicate with a variety of personalities in a tactful, pleasant, and collaborative manner
Excellent oral and written communication skills

Experience with constituent-focused and results-driven policymaking
Ability to handle multiple projects in a fast-paced environment and meet tight deadlines

description: The Democratic Staff of the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform has an immediate need to hire a seasoned Senior Counsel to help lead high-profile, complex legal investigations—work that mirrors the rigor and pressure of a major federal prosecution. The role involves leading investigations, conducting interviews and depositions, driving hearing preparation, drafting high-impact written work products, overseeing evidence and e-discovery workflows, and providing strategic counsel to Democratic Members and senior staff.
responsibilities: Lead Investigations: Serve as lead counsel on sophisticated inquiries—scoping facts, drafting investigative plans, managing timelines, and steering cross-functional teams.

Interviews & Depositions: Prepare witnesses and conduct transcribed interviews and depositions; develop outlines and exhibits; protect the record; and manage privilege, confidentiality, and classification issues.
Hearings & Briefings: Drive end-to-end hearing prep—fact memos, exhibits, testimony prep, member questioning, and rapid response.
Written Work Product: Draft high-impact statements, memoranda, letters, subpoenas and document requests, reports, and public-facing materials that translate complex facts into clear findings.
Evidence & E-Discovery: Oversee document collection, review protocols, and e-discovery workflows; coordinate with staff on review and productions.
Strategic Counsel: Advise Democratic Members and senior staff on posture, precedent, and investigative strategy within the Committee's jurisdiction.
qualifications: At least 10+ years of legal experience, including substantial, hands-on investigative leadership—e.g., complex litigation, public corruption, white-collar, major civil or criminal enforcement, or comparable internal investigations.
Proven record conducting and leading interviews/depositions and managing sensitive fact patterns under intense public scrutiny.
Strong collaborative leadership skills (the ability to coordinate across Member offices, agencies, and stakeholders while keeping a fast operational tempo).
Exceptional writing and research skills with the ability to distill dense records into precise, persuasive work products on tight deadlines.
Sound political and legal judgment, with the discretion to handle confidential and sensitive information.
Preferred: Capitol Hill, Executive Branch, or prior oversight experience.
Preferred: Trial or grand-jury practice; complex e-discovery; privilege and classification issues; drafting subpoenas and managing compliance.
Preferred: Security clearance at the TS or TS-SCI level.
how_to_apply: Submit a resume and cover letter as ONE PDF titled "LastName.FirstName" to oversightjobs@mail.house.gov with "Senior Counsel" in the subject line by September 23, 2025, at midnight. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. No calls or walk-ins please.
equal_opportunity: Applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including marital or parental status), sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, or national origin.
